_comment: VALID on purpose, and specific to this package: in 0.3 the two image forms were the only URLs pinned to `^https://`. 0.4.0 relaxes both to `^https?://`, so a poster served over plain http is no longer a validation error. Both entry forms are here — bare string and object with alt — because the relaxation had to happen twice in the schema, and one of the two is exactly what a re-tightening would miss.
name: Taller de introducción a Git
